Name: Nophah
ModernLocation: Disputed; proposed in Moab (Kerak area) or as Nobah (Qanawat area)
Description: A place named in the old song of Heshbon, where Israel's victories are sung as far as Nophah, 'which reacheth unto Medeba.'
BiblicalSignificance: Nophah is a name in a victory song, the far point of a poem about Heshbon's fall.
